description: Betting lines from VegasInsider's odds screens (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college football/basketball): every listed game with VI event ID, start time, teams with rotation numbers and, per market (spread, total or moneyline), the opening line, each US sportsbook's line and price (bet365, BetMGM, DraftKings, Caesars, FanDuel, Hard Rock, Fanatics, BetRivers) and VI's consensus. American odds; 'even' is +100. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_covers when you need sportsbook odds from Covers.com odds screens: every listed; sports_action_network when you need US sports betting lines from Action Network's scoreboard. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
